tagline: Programming with maximum meaning per token.
compilation_pipeline: static checking + storage effects + resolved calls
native_runtime_library: platform static archive: libquidra_runtime.a on Linux/macOS; quidra_runtime.lib on Windows
native_runtime_model: small C ABI support library linked into generated executables; language semantics remain in the checked IR pipeline
binding_model: typed optional initializer with definite initialization; const T requires an initializer and removes write authority through that binding; fixed arrays allocate storage immediately with per-element initialization tracking; class fields may be partially initialized; auto requires initializer
call_style: positional arguments must precede named name = value arguments; each parameter may be supplied exactly once; unknown names, excess positional arguments, and missing required parameters are rejected with parameter-specific diagnostics; typed default parameters; reference parameters use & at the call site whether read/write or const-readonly
write_capability: &storage forms a safe abstract storage address; T & is read/write access; const T & is live read-only access; const removes write authority only through that access path and does not freeze the underlying storage
error_model: union containing error; try propagates error; exhaustive typed match
union_class_payload_model: class values must be fully definitely initialized before conversion into a union; matching a class alternative restores that complete initialization fact
array_type_syntax: T[], T[n]; dimensions precede name, outer dimension first; array(n) creates runtime-sized uninitialized element storage with explicit type context; array(n, fill = element) is fully initialized and evaluates the fill expression once before copying it with value semantics
array_growth_model: append(value), concat(other) and sorted() return new T[] values and never resize the receiver storage in place; sorted() is available on numeric, bool and string arrays of fixed or runtime size and is stable and non-mutating
compound_assignment_model: +=, -=, *=, /=, %=; assignment target is evaluated exactly once
loop_control_model: break and continue target the nearest loop; writable for iteration commits the current element before either control transfer
string_escape_model: backslash is literal; named immutable string values represent control characters
class_model: single class construct; partial named field construction; fresh field defaults; field-level definite initialization; fields and methods; no self/this; deep value semantics preserving initialization state
inheritance_model: single inheritance with class Child : Parent; explicit exact-signature override; super.method(...) statically calls the direct-parent-visible implementation; parent and child remain distinct types; no implicit class conversion or dynamic dispatch; use unions for alternatives
reference_binding_model: T &alias = &storage is a read/write live reference; const T &view = &storage is a read-only live reference; aliases may target bindings, fields, and array elements; writable references may be rebound with &alias = &other, const references may not; authority may be reduced but not recovered through a const path; references are not storable values
const_model: path-local authority: const T is an immutable initialized value binding; const T & is an initialized live read-only storage path; other writable aliases may still change the underlying storage; a const path cannot write, rebind, or manufacture T &
reference_aliasing_model: multiple references may alias the same storage, including mixed const T & and T & parameters; f(&data, &data) is valid when signatures permit those reference forms
address_model: &storage is a safe abstract storage address, not a numeric pointer; & means storage access rather than write permission by itself; no * dereference operator, pointer arithmetic, address-to-int conversion, or is identity operator
equality_model: == and != compare values; class comparison recursively compares definitely initialized fields; arrays and bin compare contents; storage identity is not exposed
module_model: standard namespaces are always visible and cannot be imported or aliased; unquoted non-standard names resolve to installed packages without local-file fallback; quoted relative paths resolve from importer; quoted @/ paths resolve from command working directory; imported source modules are declaration-only; cycles rejected
cli_model: one declarative cli binding per root source; argument() is positional, option(default = value) maps the field name to --name, flag() maps the field name to a bool flag; scalar CLI values support string, int, float, bigint, bigreal, and bool, with exact numeric text parsed directly for bigint/bigreal; typed values are validated before normal execution; functions do not implicitly capture the top-level cli binding
file_model: standard file module with explicit whole-text read/write and whole-binary read_bin/write_bin plus exists/is_directory/remove/copy/move/mkdir and deterministic sorted list; text reads require valid UTF-8 without NUL; binary I/O preserves arbitrary byte-aligned bin payloads exactly; list paths are converted to valid UTF-8 text; operational or text-representation failures are returned through error unions
environment_model: environment.get(name) returns string | none; environment.has(name) returns bool; absence is normal none; invalid host text fails deterministically rather than entering string storage
test_model: test.check requires bool; test.equal reuses ordinary value equality; assertion failure exits with status 1
time_model: time.Instant is monotonic-clock state; time.Duration is an opaque duration value; time.now/since/seconds/sleep preserve time units in the type instead of exposing unitless numeric timestamps
random_model: random.generator(seed) creates an explicit deterministic Generator value; Generator.int uses a half-open [start,end) range without modulo bias; Generator.float returns [0,1); Generator.bool returns a deterministic bit; ordinary Generator assignment copies RNG state independently
process_model: process.run(program,args) launches the executable directly without implicit shell parsing and returns process.Result with started/status/output/error; output/error are UTF-8 text without NUL and invalid captured text fails deterministically; launch failure is distinct from a started process returning nonzero; process.exit(status) terminates the current program with the supplied int status and is namespaced rather than consuming the bare name exit
map_model: map.Map<K,V> is a deterministic insertion-ordered independent value container; set replaces an existing key without reordering, get returns V | none, keys/values return value arrays; current keys are fixed-width integers, bigint, bool, or string; bigreal is excluded because symbolic equality may require bounded proof
set_model: set.Set<T> is a deterministic insertion-ordered independent value container; add is idempotent, values returns insertion order; current elements are fixed-width integers, bigint, bool, or string; bigreal is excluded because symbolic equality may require bounded proof
json_model: json.parse returns immutable json.Value | error; JSON null remains a Value while missing object/array lookups return none; typed accessors return error on kind mismatch; duplicate keys are rejected; encode preserves object insertion order and number spelling; equal provides explicit structural equality
http_model: http.get(url) returns http.Response | error; response status/body(bin)/case-insensitive header lookup are explicit; HTTP 4xx/5xx remain Response while DNS/TLS/connection/timeout/protocol failures are error; only http/https are permitted and TLS verification remains enabled
generic_model: classes/functions/methods are monomorphized before checking; function and method type arguments are inferred when every generic parameter is uniquely determined by call arguments, otherwise explicit type arguments are required
numeric_model: int/int64 are signed 64-bit; float/float64 are IEEE-754 binary64; fixed-width signed/unsigned integers and float32 are explicit; bigint is an exact arbitrary-precision integer; bigreal stores exact rationals and exact symbolic real expressions without NaN or infinity
numeric_implicit_conversion_model: already-typed numeric values never change representation implicitly; integer-family literals materialize only under a unique integer-family context and real-family literals only under a unique real-family context; auto and generic inference never choose a numeric concrete type from a bare literal
numeric_explicit_cast_model: T(value) is the single explicit numeric cast form: for a scalar it changes that value, for nested numeric arrays it preserves every array dimension while recursively changing numeric leaves, for tensors it preserves rank/shape constraints and inferred facts while changing element dtype, and for neural values float32/float conversion preserves shape facts and autograd graph provenance; integer narrowing is runtime range-checked and never wraps; integer-to-float and float-to-float permit deterministic IEEE-754 rounding; float-to-integer requires math.trunc/math.round/math.floor/math.ceil; container-specific cast methods are not part of the language
numeric_text_model: numeric Type.parse(string) returns T | error; scalar value.string() returns the standard textual representation
bin_model: mutable packed raw bit sequence; bin.fill(n, bit) allocates bits, bin.parse(text) parses written bits, bin(value) is explicit representation conversion; indexing returns one-bit bin, slicing/iteration operate on bits, len counts bits, and equality compares values
value_copy_optimization_model: ordinary = has independent value semantics; unobservable storage sharing, copy-on-write, copy elision, moves and reference counting are permitted; tensor views/copies currently use COW; & introduces observable aliasing
string_storage_model: string is immutable valid UTF-8 text with no embedded NUL; external text ingress validates before constructing a string; storage may be shared when unobservable
string_operation_model: len/index/find/slice use Unicode code-point positions; text[index] returns a one-code-point string; contains/starts_with/ends_with/find/slice/trim/split/utf8/codepoints are supported; string[] join(separator) assembles text in one operation, and repeated text = text + piece is linear overall because a sole-owner append reuses storage unobservably
semantic_compression: surface syntax minimizes ceremony while preserving distinctions that change meaning
compiler_stage_model: parsed Program -> ResolvedProgram -> ConcreteProgram -> CheckedProgram -> typed IR
ir_reference_authority_model: typed IR preserves const/reference authority for parameters and local reference bindings even though T & and const T & share the same native pointer ABI
call_resolution_model: checker resolves each direct call as function, builtin, exact numeric cast, or constructor before IR lowering
storage_effect_model: StorageEffect tracks requires, writes, initializes, invalidates for method receivers and reference parameters; const reference paths can require initialized storage but cannot contribute writes/initializes/invalidates; fixed-point summaries compose across calls
inspect_authority_model: typed source inspection preserves sparse const/reference authority for bindings, fields, and function parameters even when source text is omitted
none_model: none is a literal union alternative, not a synthetic function call
builtin_registry_model: builtin type names, aliases, callables, reserved-name checks, and describe output share one registry
value_storage_policy: Direct, ImmutableShared, or IndependentStorage; direct calls internally borrow provably read-only by-value aggregates, while independently mutable aggregates clone when independent ownership is required; future COW remains permitted when unobservable
memory_management_model: deterministic managed ownership; typed IR emits retain/release, safe references pin containing allocations, composite drops recursively release children, and stdlib calls borrow operands unless ownership transfer is explicit
managed_registry_model: per-execution-thread ownership registry without process-wide locking; owner/pin overflow and underflow are runtime-checked; current language semantics do not expose cross-thread managed-value sharing
call_depth_model: dynamic depth guards are emitted for functions participating in recursive call cycles; acyclic direct calls carry no depth-bookkeeping overhead
native_optimization_level: Clang -O3 without fast-math; checked arithmetic and language safety semantics remain explicit
debugger_integration: quidra build --debug emits an unoptimized frame-pointer-preserving native binary without dead stripping; quidra debug launches lldb/gdb or QUIDRA_DEBUGGER; function/symbol debugging is supported while fine-grained Quidra source-line DWARF is not yet claimed
c_ffi_model: explicit top-level C symbol declarations: scalar/void results and scalar/bool by-value inputs; managed UTF-8 string/bin inputs require explicit const T & call-scoped read borrows and &storage calls, then lower to adjacent nonnull readonly nocapture data pointer + uint64 byte-length pairs with no C-string or encoding-conversion assumption; `main`, the compiler-owned `n_*` mangling namespace, `quidra_*`/`__quidra_*` implementation namespaces, and runtime-prelude symbols cannot be rebound; each external C symbol has one source binding per compilation, 8/16-bit integer and bool C ABI extension attributes are explicit, no implicit errno/null/ownership failure conversion, and foreign calls are replay barriers
package_management_model: local deterministic package store management: validate then atomic install, explicit force replacement, symlink rejection, no install scripts or implicit network access
package_lock_model: optional project quidra.lock pins the exact resolved direct/transitive installed-package name graph by deterministic package-tree SHA-256; compiler and LSP reject missing, extra, malformed, duplicate, or hash-mismatched lock state when present; package lock --check is non-writing
lsp_model: stdio LSP with protocol-default UTF-16 positions, full-document sync, compiler-backed diagnostics through an unsaved root-source overlay, and document formatting
formatter_model: lexer-span-based conservative canonical spacing; preserves literal/comment text and avoids guessing context-dependent angle/colon roles; fmt --check is non-writing
repl_model: accumulated accepted source; declaration-only submissions are validated and accepted without LLVM/native execution; executable submissions still compile accumulated source and reconstruct runtime state, with replay barriers for external/nondeterministic effects
repl_expression_display: typed IR display operation; void and never are not displayed; previously emitted stdout is baseline-filtered on later submissions
repl_state_persistence: bindings, declarations, functions, classes, generics, and file-aware imports are reconstructed from accepted source on each successful submission rather than stored in a persistent JIT heap
function_value_model: function declarations are callable names, not first-class values; using a function as a value is rejected explicitly
static_index_model: constant indices into arrays with statically known length are bounds-checked at compile time
array_initialization_optimization_model: typed IR preserves conservative full-initialization proofs for local arrays; LLVM may elide only redundant per-element initialization checks; whole-array read/write address escape and uncertain control-flow joins drop the proof, while const read-only address formation preserves it; bounds checks remain independent
name_resolution_model: absolute reservation plus monotonic visibility: user code may never reuse a language-reserved identifier in any declaration position, including fields and methods; non-reserved names may not shadow currently visible declarations but may be reused in disjoint scopes where the earlier name is not visible; standard-library internal generated declarations are the implementation-owned exception
tensor_model: tensor<T> is a first-class dense numeric value with mandatory static element dtype and unrestricted rank/shape; tensor<T><D0, D1, ...> adds an exact-rank shape pattern whose axis entries are _ wildcards or integer expressions; the number of pattern axes is the required rank, _ means that axis exists but its extent is unrestricted, compile-time expressions are folded, and runtime expressions are evaluated once and captured when the binding is created; dtype/shape are deliberately separated into distinct angle groups; captured constraints survive reassignment while inferred rank/known-shape facts are flow-sensitive and may weaken; shape() returns int[N] when rank is known and int[] otherwise; item(), linear.dot, linear.matmul, and image APIs exploit these facts for static rejection or runtime constraint checks
tensor_initialization_model: tensor<T>(shape) creates per-element uninitialized storage; tensor.zeros<T>(shape) and tensor.ones<T>(shape) are fully initialized; tensor.zeros()/tensor.ones() may derive dtype and allocation shape from a fully specified expected exact shape but reject unconstrained rank or _ extents; shape knowledge never implies value initialization; uninitialized reads fail deterministically
tensor_value_model: tensor copies and slices preserve source-level independent value semantics; internal storage sharing is permitted and mutation detaches with copy-on-write; slice assignment and writable tensor-element references are not exposed
tensor_device_model: CPU is the default tensor placement; gpu = n requests direct allocation on a non-negative Quidra GPU index; .gpu(n) and .cpu() are explicit copy boundaries; device is runtime/compiler metadata rather than nominal tensor type; implicit CPU/GPU or GPU/GPU transfer and CPU fallback are forbidden; operations preserve input placement and unsupported GPU operations fail explicitly

gpu_backend_model.index_space: one zero-based Quidra GPU index space per process

nvidia.managed_component_lock: future bundled NVIDIA user-space components are fixed per Quidra release by version, artifact identity, and checksum

gpu_backend_model.dnn_acceleration_owner: official dnn package owns cuDNN/cuBLAS/NCCL or platform equivalents

standard_namespace_model: standard namespaces themselves are reserved identifiers everywhere in user code; their qualified member names are resolved inside the namespace and do not automatically become global reserved identifiers; only referenced standard implementations are linked
package_model: unquoted non-standard imports resolve installed packages from configured package paths and never fall back to the current source directory
stats_model: stats.mean(tensor) returns a float mean and rejects empty or uninitialized tensor input
linear_model: linear.dot(a,b) performs checked rank-1 dot product and returns the preserved scalar element type; linear.matmul(a,b) performs checked rank-2 matrix multiplication for tensors with identical element types; dimensions must be compatible and integer multiplication/accumulation overflow remains checked
image_model: image.read(path) preserves decoded CHW dtype/channels; an expected tensor dtype/exact-rank shape pattern such as tensor<uint8><3, _, _> is a non-converting acceptance constraint; channels = 1|3|4 explicitly converts channel layout and dtype = numeric_type explicitly converts sample representation without normalization; RGB-to-gray uses 0.299R+0.587G+0.114B, alpha removal occurs only under an explicit channel conversion, and image.read results have compiler-known rank 3; image.write preserves dtype exactly and rejects unsupported codec representations
named_writable_argument_model: for read/write T & parameters, positional arguments use &value and named arguments use &name = &value
named_reference_argument_model: positional reference arguments use &value; named reference arguments use &name = &value; the callee parameter T & versus const T & determines read/write versus read-only authority
neural_model: neural is neural<float32> by default; neural<D0, D1, ...> is shorthand for neural<float32><D0, D1, ...>; neural<T><D0, D1, ...> uses the same exact-rank _/integer-expression shape pattern and binding-time captured extent semantics as tensor while neural<T> leaves rank/shape unrestricted; neural values are immutable differentiable values on a Define-by-Run graph; track preserves tensor rank/shape facts in the graph root, untrack restores them to an ordinary tensor, floating numeric casts preserve graph provenance, and grad(loss) returns an independent neural.Gradients value without hidden .grad accumulation
neural_mutation_model: neural<T> elements are read-only and graph values have no in-place mutation; ordinary = preserves independent value semantics while immutable graph provenance may be shared internally
neural_primitive_model: operand-level affine, NCHW convolution, normalization, random masking, absolute/exponential/logarithm, mean, and last-axis reductions support ordinary differentiable source packages without defining layer types in core
neural_update_model: neural.update and neural.moment_update statically enumerate nested Parameters, validate the complete gradient/model relation before mutation, skip Parameters absent from a dynamic graph, and keep optimizer policy and persistent state in ordinary source-package classes
neural_state_format: .quistate v1: typed structural snapshot with magic/version, exact nominal root model/optimizer types, field paths/types, tensor dtype/shape, and checksum; no executable code
neural_save_model: neural.save(model [, optimizer], path = *.quistate) serializes the complete supported class state graph through a process-unique temporary file followed by atomic replacement; there is no separate checkpoint API
neural_load_model: neural.load(&model = &model [, &optimizer = &optimizer], path = *.quistate) prevalidates the complete payload before mutation, requires exact schema, restores existing storage in place, preserves Parameter tensor identity, and rejects mismatches without partial restoration
neural_dtype_model: neural<T> and Parameter<T> support float32 or float only; State<T> remains general-purpose
neural_parameter_identity: opaque managed-allocation generation, never a raw address; preserved by in-place load/update, distinct on value copy, and immune to allocator address reuse
